caption: The drawing is divided into five rectangular and square sections, each containing abstract or geometric forms against a muted gray background. The top left section depicts two red, lizard-like figures with hand-shaped feet and diamond-shaped markings, one upright and one inverted, with a yellow and white circular shape above the upper figure. The top right section contains a series of linear and curved shapes in red and black, with two stick-figure forms in black and several circular and dotted elements in red, arranged horizontally. The bottom left section shows a large, spiral-like configuration in dark blue with branching lines, dots, and circular formations in red and white. The bottom middle section has a central, vertically oriented, undulating shape bordered in red and filled with dark blue lines. The bottom right section features a concentric circular pattern, with an innermost red circle surrounded by alternating red and dark blue segments, all contained within a thick, dark blue outer ring. All shapes and lines are rendered with a stippled or pointillist texture.
title: Petroglyph
